languageData.TentacleIngest.label: ingest tentacle
languageData.TentacleIngest.description: Ingests the selected Amor Squirmer into the Host.
languageData.TentacleExpel.label: expel tentacle
languageData.TentacleExpel.description: Expels an Amor Squirmer tentacle from the Host.\n\nWARNING: This is dangerous if the pawn runs out of stored tentacles!
languageData.TentacleTransfer.label: transfer tentacle
languageData.TentacleTransfer.description: Transfer an Amor Squirmer tentacle from one Host to another. With a sloppy kiss.\n\nWARNING: This is dangerous if the pawn runs out of stored tentacles!
languageData.SeductionKiss.label: seduction kiss
languageData.SeductionKiss.description: Plant an Amor Squirmer in the target, weakening and incapacitating them for a short time. Costs one stored tentacle.
languageData.PlacatingKiss.label: placating kiss
languageData.PlacatingKiss.description: Use the Amor Squirmers inside the Host to calm a pawn and end their mental break. Costs one stored tentacle.
languageData.IncubateAmorBroodMotherEgg.label: Incubate Amor Brood Mother egg
languageData.IncubateAmorBroodMotherEgg.description: Begin the process of incubating a massive Amor Brood Mother egg.
languageData.BirthAmorBroodMotherEgg.label: Lay Amor Brood Mother egg
languageData.BirthAmorBroodMotherEgg.description: Begin laying a massive Amor Brood Mother egg.\n\nWARNING: This process is very debilitating for the Host. Make sure she gets somewhere safe, quickly!
languageData.TCumSpray.label: cum spray
languageData.TCumSpray.description: Expel tentacle slime-cum from the Host's mouth in a long-range cone. Puts out fires - and sometimes pushes pawns into sexual overdrive, where they force themselves on anyone nearby.
languageData.AbilityTentacleUnbirth.label: crawl inside
languageData.AbilityTentacleUnbirth.description: Commands the Amor Squirmer to crawl inside the targeted Host, adding tentacle resources.
languageData.AbilityLarvaEvolveSquirmer.label: evolve into squirmers
languageData.AbilityLarvaEvolveSquirmer.description: Evolve the Larva into a small handful of Squirmers. Inefficient, but if you need some and don't have Spawners available...
languageData.AbilityLarvaEvolveSpawner.label: evolve into spawner
languageData.AbilityLarvaEvolveSpawner.description: Evolve the Larva into an Amor Spawner, which will in turn produce Amor Squirmers.
